column3: To save power, the switch stays on for the current session only. It turns off when driving starts; turn it on again next time.

• Detection is weaker in poor light or when cameras are dirty. 
• People passing slowly may trigger false alerts. 
• Vibration detection does not cover light scratches or knocks. 
• Sentry is unavailable while Pet, Rest and other modes are on.
Note: a loud alarm plays when triggered, so do not leave people or animals inside. Sentry records video; use only where local law allows.

Sentry is on but no USB drive found. Alerts work, videos cannot be saved. Check:
· USB drive inserted correctly 
· Size between 512 MB and 256 GB 
· Format is FAT32 
· Drive is not damaged
When on, the exterior cameras record and process data. Follow local laws and use this feature only where allowed; otherwise you are responsible for the consequences.
